After SPACE: the **yellow cross shifted down 6 px** (center now (27,21), same row as blue cross), and the **white dot moved from blue cross center to the yellow cross's new center (27,21)**. Blue cross shape unchanged but lost the white dot. So SPACE transferred the white marker to the yellow cross, which moved to the ball's landing point on its vertical bar.
Hypothesis: white dot = ball fired from blue cross toward yellow cross; yellow cross recenters on impact. Uncertain: firing direction rule, goal.
Plan: press SPACE again to observe the second firing.
